Sarajevo Tram, Trolleybus and Bus Announcer

Sarajevo · Trolejbus · Najava stajališta

103Dobrinja⇄Austrijski trg

A working passenger information system for Sarajevo's trams, trolleybuses and buses. Pick a line: it runs the front destination sign and the interior display, and announces each stop in Bosnian with an English follow-up. Let it drive the route on its own, or run it stop by stop from the driver console.

Checking the voices on this device…

Trase minibusa su približne · Minibus routes are approximate: OpenStreetMap maps none, so each is rebuilt from the Ministry of Transport network study's stop list along OpenStreetMap streets.

Press Depart or Auto run to start the trip.

Turn on sound to hear the announcements.

    Voice settings

    No Bosnian voice? Croatian and Serbian voices read the stop names correctly. On a Mac, add Croatian (Lana) in System Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → Manage Voices. On Windows, add Croatian in Settings → Time & language → Speech. Microsoft Edge has Gabrijela, the neural Croatian voice this page uses as its announcer.
